title: 302. Single Number II

examples.explanation: 2 appears three times while 3 appears once.
0 and 1 each appear three times; 99 is the single one.

hints: Count set bits per position: bits whose count is not a multiple of 3 belong to the answer.
A two-variable bit state machine (ones, twos) achieves O(1) space without per-bit loops.
Remember to handle negative numbers via 32-bit two's complement behavior.
